messages:
marco.dev: hey team, day 1 here. quick org-map q: who should I cc for cross-team escalations (prod-impacting), who approves short-term dataset access for experiments, and who owns feature-flag management? skimmed the org chart but still fuzzy.
leah-prodsteward: welcome @marco.dev! for prod-impacting incidents create an incident channel and SRE will triage; they page product stewards as needed. For contractual or customer SLA escalations loop @evan-acctmgmt + legal.
emma-platform: feature flags are in the platform flag-registry. ping me (@emma-platform) for a staging-scoped flag; we usually create ttl=24h test flags. CLI helper:
```
flagctl create --name=your-flag --env=staging --ttl=24h --owner=marco.dev
```
dan-security: dataset access -> open a DATA-ACCESS ticket with dataset id, purpose, retention. Sensitive data requires DPA + manager sign-off. For quick analytics read-only ask for role `analytics_ro`.
ops-oncall-bot: To open an incident channel: `/incident create "service-name" severity=sev2 reporter=@marco.dev` — follow prompts. Sev1 triggers phone tree.
karen-people: FYI new hires should finish security training by day 5 to avoid delays on approvals. Long-lived access (>30d) needs manager + security approval. People Ops handles badge/offboard flows.
marco.dev: thanks all! i'll open DATA-ACCESS and an incident channel if I hit a prod error. @emma-platform i'll DM the desired flag name. appreciate the map :raised_hands:
